verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a dedicated Vendors module in its data library, with documented Vendor Risk Assessment and Send-and-Review Security Questionnaires workflows, plus Vendor Data APIs. Its AI-systems due diligence docs add reviewing vendor security posture, requesting compliance documents from vendors and tracking submissions. Most vendor-module evidence is page titles only, so depth is thinly shown. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking vendor data access, configurable review cadence or reminders, detailed vendor-inventory field documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
